What does the character quality “Love” look like?
back: Love seeks the good of another. God loved us first.
extra: 1 John 4:8 — He that loveth not knoweth not God; for God is love.

front: What does the character quality “Joy” look like?
back: Joy is gladness in the Lord, not only when things go our way.
extra: Philippians 4:4 — Rejoice in the Lord alway: and again I say, Rejoice.

front: What does the character quality “Peace” look like?
back: Peace is quiet trust, and peacemakers help others rest too.
extra: Matthew 5:9 — Blessed are the peacemakers: for they shall be called the children of God.

front: What does the character quality “Patience” look like?
back: Patience waits without snapping. Scripture also calls it longsuffering.
extra: Galatians 5:22-23 — But the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, longsuffering, gentleness, goodness, faith, Meekness, temperance: against such there is no law.

front: What does the character quality “Kindness” look like?
back: Kindness is tender help. Be kind, tenderhearted, and ready to forgive.
extra: Ephesians 4:32 — And be ye kind one to another, tenderhearted, forgiving one another, even as God for Christ’s sake hath forgiven you.

front: What does the character quality “Goodness” look like?
back: Goodness chooses what is right even when no one is watching.
extra: Romans 12:21 — Be not overcome of evil, but overcome evil with good.

front: What does the character quality “Faith” look like?
back: Faith trusts the Lord with the whole heart and leans not on ourselves.
extra: Proverbs 3:5 — Trust in the LORD with all thine heart; and lean not unto thine own understanding.

front: What does the character quality “Gentleness” look like?
back: Gentleness is strength under control. A soft answer turns away wrath.
extra: Proverbs 15:1 — A soft answer turneth away wrath: but grievous words stir up anger.

front: What does the character quality “Self-control” look like?
back: Self-control holds the tongue, the hands, and the wants.
extra: Galatians 5:22-23 — But the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, longsuffering, gentleness, goodness, faith, Meekness, temperance: against such there is no law.

front: What does the character quality “Courage” look like?
back: Courage is not loudness. It is obeying God when you feel small.
extra: Joshua 1:9 — Have not I commanded thee? Be strong and of a good courage; be not afraid, neither be thou dismayed: for the LORD thy God is with thee whithersoever thou goest.

front: What does the character quality “Honesty” look like?
back: Honesty tells the truth and keeps its word.
extra: James 1:22 — But be ye doers of the word, and not hearers only, deceiving your own selves.

front: What does the character quality “Gratitude” look like?
back: Gratitude says thank you to God, because His mercy lasts.
extra: Psalms 136:1 — O give thanks unto the LORD; for he is good: for his mercy endureth for ever.

front: What does the character quality “Obedience” look like?
back: Obedience is doing what is asked, as unto the Lord.
extra: Ephesians 6:1 — Children, obey your parents in the Lord: for this is right.

front: What does the character quality “Mercy” look like?
back: Mercy does not give the hurt someone earned. It stoops to help.
extra: Micah 6:8 — He hath shewed thee, O man, what is good; and what doth the LORD require of thee, but to do justly, and to love mercy, and to walk humbly with thy God?

front: What does the character quality “Forgiveness” look like?
back: Forgiveness lets go of a debt, as God in Christ forgave us.
extra: Ephesians 4:32 — And be ye kind one to another, tenderhearted, forgiving one another, even as God for Christ’s sake hath forgiven you.

front: What does the character quality “Hope” look like?
back: Hope looks forward because God is faithful, even in hard days.
extra: Romans 8:28 — And we know that all things work together for good to them that love God, to them who are the called according to his purpose.

front: What does the character quality “Love” look like?
back: Love seeks the good of another. God loved us first.
extra: 1 John 4:8 — He that loveth not knoweth not God; for God is love.

front: What does the character quality “Joy” look like?
back: Joy is gladness in the Lord, not only when things go our way.
extra: Philippians 4:4 — Rejoice in the Lord alway: and again I say, Rejoice.

front: What does the character quality “Peace” look like?
back: Peace is quiet trust, and peacemakers help others rest too.
extra: Matthew 5:9 — Blessed are the peacemakers: for they shall be called the children of God.

front: What does the character quality “Patience” look like?
back: Patience waits without snapping. Scripture also calls it longsuffering.
extra: Galatians 5:22-23 — But the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, longsuffering, gentleness, goodness, faith, Meekness, temperance: against such there is no law.

front: What does the character quality “Kindness” look like?
back: Kindness is tender help. Be kind, tenderhearted, and ready to forgive.
extra: Ephesians 4:32 — And be ye kind one to another, tenderhearted, forgiving one another, even as God for Christ’s sake hath forgiven you.

front: What does the character quality “Goodness” look like?
back: Goodness chooses what is right even when no one is watching.
extra: Romans 12:21 — Be not overcome of evil, but overcome evil with good.

front: What does the character quality “Faith” look like?
back: Faith trusts the Lord with the whole heart and leans not on ourselves.
extra: Proverbs 3:5 — Trust in the LORD with all thine heart; and lean not unto thine own understanding.

front: What does the character quality “Gentleness” look like?
back: Gentleness is strength under control. A soft answer turns away wrath.
extra: Proverbs 15:1 — A soft answer turneth away wrath: but grievous words stir up anger.

front: What does the character quality “Self-control” look like?
back: Self-control holds the tongue, the hands, and the wants.
extra: Galatians 5:22-23 — But the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, longsuffering, gentleness, goodness, faith, Meekness, temperance: against such there is no law.

front: What does the character quality “Courage” look like?
back: Courage is not loudness. It is obeying God when you feel small.
extra: Joshua 1:9 — Have not I commanded thee? Be strong and of a good courage; be not afraid, neither be thou dismayed: for the LORD thy God is with thee whithersoever thou goest.

front: What does the character quality “Honesty” look like?
back: Honesty tells the truth and keeps its word.
extra: James 1:22 — But be ye doers of the word, and not hearers only, deceiving your own selves.

front: What does the character quality “Humility” look like?
back: Humility walks low before God and does not put others down.
extra: Micah 6:8 — He hath shewed thee, O man, what is good; and what doth the LORD require of thee, but to do justly, and to love mercy, and to walk humbly with thy God?

front: What does the character quality “Gratitude” look like?
back: Gratitude says thank you to God, because His mercy lasts.
extra: Psalms 136:1 — O give thanks unto the LORD; for he is good: for his mercy endureth for ever.

front: What does the character quality “Obedience” look like?
back: Obedience is doing what is asked, as unto the Lord.
extra: Ephesians 6:1 — Children, obey your parents in the Lord: for this is right.

front: What does the character quality “Mercy” look like?
back: Mercy does not give the hurt someone earned. It stoops to help.
extra: Micah 6:8 — He hath shewed thee, O man, what is good; and what doth the LORD require of thee, but to do justly, and to love mercy, and to walk humbly with thy God?

front: What does the character quality “Wisdom” look like?
back: Wisdom starts with trusting the Lord, then choosing the good path.
extra: Proverbs 3:5 — Trust in the LORD with all thine heart; and lean not unto thine own understanding.

front: What does the character quality “Diligence” look like?
back: Diligence works heartily, as to the Lord, not only when watched.
extra: Colossians 3:23 — And whatsoever ye do, do it heartily, as to the Lord, and not unto men;

front: What does the character quality “Forgiveness” look like?
back: Forgiveness lets go of a debt, as God in Christ forgave us.
extra: Ephesians 4:32 — And be ye kind one to another, tenderhearted, forgiving one another, even as God for Christ’s sake hath forgiven you.

front: What does the character quality “Hope” look like?
back: Hope looks forward because God is faithful, even in hard days.
extra: Romans 8:28 — And we know that all things work together for good to them that love God, to them who are the called according to his purpose.

front: What does the character quality “Love” look like?
back: Love seeks the good of another. God loved us first.
extra: 1 John 4:8 — He that loveth not knoweth not God; for God is love.

front: What does the character quality “Joy” look like?
back: Joy is gladness in the Lord, not only when things go our way.
extra: Philippians 4:4 — Rejoice in the Lord alway: and again I say, Rejoice.

front: What does the character quality “Peace” look like?
back: Peace is quiet trust, and peacemakers help others rest too.
extra: Matthew 5:9 — Blessed are the peacemakers: for they shall be called the children of God.

front: What does the character quality “Patience” look like?
back: Patience waits without snapping. Scripture also calls it longsuffering.
extra: Galatians 5:22-23 — But the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, longsuffering, gentleness, goodness, faith, Meekness, temperance: against such there is no law.

front: What does the character quality “Kindness” look like?
back: Kindness is tender help. Be kind, tenderhearted, and ready to forgive.
extra: Ephesians 4:32 — And be ye kind one to another, tenderhearted, forgiving one another, even as God for Christ’s sake hath forgiven you.

front: What does the character quality “Goodness” look like?
back: Goodness chooses what is right even when no one is watching.
extra: Romans 12:21 — Be not overcome of evil, but overcome evil with good.

front: What does the character quality “Faith” look like?
back: Faith trusts the Lord with the whole heart and leans not on ourselves.
extra: Proverbs 3:5 — Trust in the LORD with all thine heart; and lean not unto thine own understanding.

front: What does the character quality “Gentleness” look like?
back: Gentleness is strength under control. A soft answer turns away wrath.
extra: Proverbs 15:1 — A soft answer turneth away wrath: but grievous words stir up anger.

front: What does the character quality “Self-control” look like?
back: Self-control holds the tongue, the hands, and the wants.
extra: Galatians 5:22-23 — But the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, longsuffering, gentleness, goodness, faith, Meekness, temperance: against such there is no law.

front: What does the character quality “Courage” look like?
back: Courage is not loudness. It is obeying God when you feel small.
extra: Joshua 1:9 — Have not I commanded thee? Be strong and of a good courage; be not afraid, neither be thou dismayed: for the LORD thy God is with thee whithersoever thou goest.

front: What does the character quality “Honesty” look like?
back: Honesty tells the truth and keeps its word.
extra: James 1:22 — But be ye doers of the word, and not hearers only, deceiving your own selves.

front: What does the character quality “Humility” look like?
back: Humility walks low before God and does not put others down.
extra: Micah 6:8 — He hath shewed thee, O man, what is good; and what doth the LORD require of thee, but to do justly, and to love mercy, and to walk humbly with thy God?

front: What does the character quality “Gratitude” look like?
back: Gratitude says thank you to God, because His mercy lasts.
extra: Psalms 136:1 — O give thanks unto the LORD; for he is good: for his mercy endureth for ever.

front: What does the character quality “Obedience” look like?
back: Obedience is doing what is asked, as unto the Lord.
extra: Ephesians 6:1 — Children, obey your parents in the Lord: for this is right.

front: What does the character quality “Mercy” look like?
back: Mercy does not give the hurt someone earned. It stoops to help.
extra: Micah 6:8 — He hath shewed thee, O man, what is good; and what doth the LORD require of thee, but to do justly, and to love mercy, and to walk humbly with thy God?

front: What does the character quality “Wisdom” look like?
back: Wisdom starts with trusting the Lord, then choosing the good path.
extra: Proverbs 3:5 — Trust in the LORD with all thine heart; and lean not unto thine own understanding.

front: What does the character quality “Diligence” look like?
back: Diligence works heartily, as to the Lord, not only when watched.
extra: Colossians 3:23 — And whatsoever ye do, do it heartily, as to the Lord, and not unto men;

front: What does the character quality “Forgiveness” look like?
back: Forgiveness lets go of a debt, as God in Christ forgave us.
extra: Ephesians 4:32 — And be ye kind one to another, tenderhearted, forgiving one another, even as God for Christ’s sake hath forgiven you.

front: What does the character quality “Hope” look like?
back: Hope looks forward because God is faithful, even in hard days.
extra: Romans 8:28 — And we know that all things work together for good to them that love God, to them who are the called according to his purpose.

front: What does the character quality “Reverence” look like?
back: Reverence honors God as worthy of glory, honor, and power.
extra: Revelation 4:11 — Thou art worthy, O Lord, to receive glory and honour and power: for thou hast created all things, and for thy pleasure they are and were created.
